description: Land Title Settlement Department - Polwaththa, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521419 (24/0876)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including specific parcel numbers, ownership details, land extents, encumbrances, and servitude rights under the Registration of Title Act.
